question: What contribution to CA Homes Committee appears in filing 3214397?

sentences.text: HOMEOWNERSHIP FOR FAMILIES AND TAX SAVINGS FOR SENIORS, SPONSORED BY THE CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF REALTORS, MAJOR FUNDING BY THE CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF REALTORS ISSUES MOBILIZATION PAC reported a $3,910,600 contribution to CA HOMES COMMITTEE on 2026-10-20.
